agentchanges.only.team: Only the app can do this, because it reaches other people or changes who works on the project. Open the project in Idiograph and go to Project settings, Working together. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.only.send: Only the app can share a copy of a project, because the copy goes to another person. In Idiograph, choose Share a copy on the project's menu on Home. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.only.seen: Only the researcher can mark agents' changes as seen, because the line on the project's card on Home is how they learn about them. In Idiograph, press Review or the cross on that line. Nothing was done.

agentchanges.seen.would.one: {n} change by agents in {project} would be marked as seen.
agentchanges.seen.would.other: {n} changes by agents in {project} would be marked as seen.

agentchanges.seen.done.one: {n} change by agents in {project} is marked as seen.
agentchanges.seen.done.other: {n} changes by agents in {project} are marked as seen.

agentchanges.seen.none: Every change by agents in {project} is already seen.
agentchanges.compact.demo: The demo keeps no restore points, so there are no copies to deflate.
agentchanges.compact.none: Every restore copy in {project} is deflated already. Nothing changed.

agentchanges.compact.would.one: {n} restore copy in {project} would be deflated.
agentchanges.compact.would.other: {n} restore copies in {project} would be deflated.

agentchanges.compact.size_would: The restore copies take {before} MB and would take about {after} MB.
agentchanges.compact.size_done: The restore copies took {before} MB and now take {after} MB.

agentchanges.compact.left.one: {n} copy does not check out and stays as it is.
agentchanges.compact.left.other: {n} copies do not check out and stay as they are.

agentchanges.compact.failed.one: {n} copy could not be deflated. Run it again.
agentchanges.compact.failed.other: {n} copies could not be deflated. Run it again.

agentchanges.compact.busy: It stopped part way because {project} was busy with another write. Run it again to finish.
agentchanges.only.settings: Only the app can change its settings. They belong to the app and not to a project, so no undo can reach them. Change them in Idiograph's Settings. Nothing was done.
agentchanges.kind.names: the list of names to replace
agentchanges.no_files: No file of the project changed.
agentchanges.removed: Removed from Idiograph's list. Its folder is left as it is.
agentchanges.removed_trash: Removed from Idiograph. Its folder was moved to the {where}.
agentchanges.head: {changes} by agents in {project}, in {runs}, newest first.
agentchanges.undo.no_run: No run of this project is called {id}. agents changes lists them.
agentchanges.undo.already: Run {id} is undone already, by run {by}. Undo that run to have it back.
agentchanges.undo.already_alone: Run {id} is undone already: it changed no file, so there was nothing to put back.
agentchanges.undo.folder: Run {id} renamed a participant's folder, so it cannot be undone whole. First rename the folder back with participant rename and --folder, then undo the run. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo.refused: Run {id} is not undone, since undoing it would lose these later changes:
agentchanges.undo.later: {what}, changed after the run's last change.
agentchanges.undo.between: {what}, changed by someone else between the run's changes.
agentchanges.undo.copies_gone: Run {id}'s restore point no longer holds {what}, so it is not undone. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo.not_kept: Not undone, because Idiograph could not keep a copy of {what} to put back later. Nothing was taken away or written.
agentchanges.undo.outside: Not undone, since the record names a file outside the project. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo.demo: The demo keeps no restore points. Reset demo puts it back as it ships.
agentchanges.undo.would: Undoing run {id} ({changes}) would put the project back as it was before its first change:
agentchanges.undo.done: Run {id} ({changes}) is undone. The project is back as it was before its first change.
agentchanges.undo.gone: Taken away because the run made them: {what}.
agentchanges.undo.again: The undo is itself run {id}. Undo that run to reverse this undo.

agentchanges.holds_cleared.one: {n} action that waited was cleared when approvals were removed.
agentchanges.holds_cleared.other: {n} actions that waited were cleared when approvals were removed.

agentchanges.undo_change.none_named: Name the change to undo by its id, c12, as agents changes gives it. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo_change.no_change: No change of this project is called {id}. agents changes lists them.
agentchanges.undo_change.already: Change {id} is undone already, by run {by}. Undo that run to have it back.
agentchanges.undo_change.run_undone: Change {id} is undone already, with its run {run}.
agentchanges.undo_change.no_copies: Change {id} keeps no copy of its files as they were before it, so it can only be undone with its run. Use agents undo-run {run}. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo_change.refused: Not undone, since undoing it would lose a later change:
agentchanges.undo_change.copies_gone: The restore points no longer hold {what} as it was, so it is not undone. Nothing was written.
agentchanges.undo_change.would: Undoing {ids} would put each file back as it was just before the change:
agentchanges.undo_change.done: Undone: {ids}. Each file is back as it was just before the change.
